source: Part catalog for ECOWAN environmental monitoring nodes.

protocols.label: LoRaWAN
protocols.description: Long-range low-power wireless link used by the gateway/node system.

protocols.label: USB
protocols.description: USB physical/interface transport; actual application protocol depends on the attached device.

protocols.label: CoAP
protocols.description: Constrained Application Protocol; exact payload/model support depends on the device.

parts.name: DHT11 temperature/humidity module
parts.description: Digital 1-wire temperature and relative humidity sensor via DHT library.
notes: Default digital 1-wire pin is GPIO4 unless reconfigured.

parts.name: HW-038 soil-moisture module
parts.description: Analog soil moisture resistance probe.
notes: Reads raw ADC counts on an analog input pin (calibration needed for percentage moisture).

parts.name: Industrial temperature/humidity sensor
parts.description: Specifications in supplied parts list: ±0.2°C and ±1.5%RH; Modbus RTU/RS-485.
notes: Requires an RS-485 transceiver and model-specific Modbus register map.

parts.name: Industrial CO₂ sensor
parts.description: 0–5000 ppm; supplied list says ±30 ppm; RS-485/Modbus.
notes: Exact model and Modbus register map must be entered before readings can be decoded.

parts.name: 4-pin light sensor module (AO + DO)
parts.description: Common small light-sensor module with VCC, GND, AO and DO. AO is a variable analog signal; DO is a thresholded digital output.
notes: Select the AO-capable GPIO in Interface / port. Enter D0 as GPIO number in the Bus address / D0 field; leave blank to use AO only.
Many modules use an LM393 comparator: DO indicates crossing its adjustable threshold, not a calibrated lux measurement.
Power the module only at a voltage compatible with its outputs; never allow AO or DO to exceed ESP32 GPIO voltage limits.

boilerplate.analog: // AO read via analogRead(); optional D0 is configured in the D0 pin field.

parts.name: Industrial light sensor
parts.description: 0–200,000 lux; RS-485/Modbus.
notes: Exact model/register map required.

parts.name: Air-pressure sensor
parts.description: Supplied list says ±0.5 hPa; Modbus RTU.
notes: Exact model/register map required.

parts.name: pH sensor
parts.description: Range 0–14 pH; ±0.01 pH; listed operating range 0–80°C.
notes: 4–20 mA requires a rated current-loop receiver; RS-485 requires transceiver and register map.

parts.name: Dissolved oxygen (DO) sensor
parts.description: 0–20 mg/L; ±0.1 mg/L; listed operating range 0–50°C.
notes: Exact model/interface and calibration required.

parts.name: Conductivity (EC) sensor
parts.description: 0–200 mS/cm; ±1% reading; listed operating range 0–60°C.
notes: Exact model/interface and calibration required.

parts.name: Flow sensor
parts.description: 0–500 m³/h depending on model; ±1% reading.
notes: Ultrasonic and electromagnetic models can have different register maps.

parts.name: Ammonia (NH₃) sensor
parts.description: 0–100 mg/L; ±2% reading; listed operating range 0–50°C.
notes: Exact model/register map and calibration required.

parts.name: Chemical oxygen demand (COD) sensor
parts.description: 0–2000 mg/L; ±5% reading.
notes: Exact model/interface and calibration required.

parts.name: Industrial I/O expander 16DI/16DO
parts.description: 16 digital inputs and 16 digital outputs; Modbus RTU/TCP.
notes: I/O control must be interlocked and validated; do not use for safety-critical control without suitable safety hardware.

parts.name: PLC, 16 input / 16 output
parts.description: Supplied list mentions RS-422 and optional RS-232/RS-485 boards; model and protocol variant not specified.
notes: Do not wire the PLC directly to ESP32 GPIO. Confirm manufacturer/model and use an approved interface.

parts.name: Industrial HMI 10-inch
parts.description: 10-inch 1280×800 touchscreen; RS-485/Ethernet/5G listed.
notes: Treat as a separate system endpoint, not a sensor directly attached to the LoRa node.

parts.name: Outdoor IoT gateway
parts.description: LoRaWAN regional bands plus Ethernet/Wi-Fi/4G/SIM; exact radio variant must be confirmed.
notes: Gateway is infrastructure, not a sensor module for an ESP32 node.

parts.name: Raspberry Pi 5 controller
parts.description: Linux single-board computer with GPIO, I²C, SPI, UART, USB and network interfaces.
notes: A separate controller class; the ESP32 sensor-node pin map does not apply.

parts.name: Industrial 5G module
parts.description: 5G NR/4G LTE; USB/PCIe depending on module.
notes: Requires exact module, carrier board, drivers, antenna and SIM/network details.

parts.name: Industrial 12 V / 3 A power supply
parts.description: 12 V / 3 A supply; AC 100–240 V input per supplied list.
notes: Not a data source. Verify electrical ratings and isolation for the installation.

parts.name: Industrial backup battery
parts.description: 12 V / 10 Ah battery per supplied list.
notes: Not a data source. Include appropriate charger, fuse and protection.

parts.name: IP67 enclosure
parts.description: Ingress-protection enclosure; listed range −20°C to 60°C.
notes: Verify cable glands, antenna layout and heat management.

parts.name: RS-485 cabling and connectors
parts.description: Twisted pair cable and industrial connectors.
notes: Physical layer accessory; not a sensor driver.

parts.name: Programming PC
parts.description: PC specified in supplied list with Intel Core Ultra 7 and RTX 5070 Ti.
notes: Build/development workstation, not an ESP32 node module.

parts.name: SSL/TLS OV certificate
parts.description: Certificate for HTTPS services.
notes: Server security item; not a sensor driver.

parts.name: AI camera module
parts.description: Supplied list says 12 MP, adjustable-focus lens; interface detail depends on the actual camera and host board.
notes: Not directly supported by the current ESP32+LoRa node; use a suitable camera host/edge computer.

parts.name: AI workstation
parts.description: Dual workstation CPU, GPU, ECC memory and NVMe storage per supplied list.
notes: Processing infrastructure, not a sensor module.

parts.name: Aluminum profile/material
parts.description: Structural material.

parts.name: Stainless steel sheet/tube
parts.description: Structural material.

parts.name: Station pole/build materials
parts.description: Pole, foundation, protection frame and electrical-safety construction materials.

parts.name: Ethernet cable
parts.description: Twisted-pair Ethernet cable with RJ45 connectors.

parts.name: Equipment enclosure box
parts.description: Listed enclosure dimensions 400×250×200 mm.

parts.name: 3D printer
parts.description: CoreXY printer; model-dependent control connection.
notes: Manufacturing tool, not an ESP32 sensor module.

parts.name: 3D-printing filament
parts.description: PA/PC/TPU/PVA material.

parts.name: Industrial Wi-Fi 6 router
parts.description: Wi-Fi 6 / Ethernet router.
notes: Network infrastructure.

parts.name: Jetson Orin NX edge computer
parts.description: 8 GB AI edge-computing module; actual connector availability depends on carrier board.
notes: Use for local AI/camera processing, not as an ESP32 sensor module.

parts.name: NB-IoT connectivity test kit
parts.description: Efento/Mobileum NB-IoT and IoT-connectivity testing suite.
notes: Test equipment/integration platform; not a direct sensor driver.

parts.name: Custom sensor/module (driver needed)
parts.description: Use when a module is not in the catalogue. The dashboard will store the configuration but cannot promise a working driver.
notes: Choose the actual electrical interface and add a driver before deploying.

current_loop.label: External rated 4–20 mA receiver (not direct GPIO)

csi2.label: Camera-capable host board, not ESP32 LoRa node
